rules_text: Every case: {name, kind, input, expected}. Integers are exact. Floats: compare with an absolute tolerance of 1e-6
(1e-5 for anything that went through a sine or a cosine). Cells and vertices are integer [x, y, z] in FORMAT space
(right-handed, +Y up, cell c covers [c, c + 1]); a set of cells is sorted by x, then y, then z.
foliage   (optional) the plants of the whole world (not of a layer). Absent: no plant.
models    an array of {id (an integer, unique), name, mesh (a .glb path RELATIVE to world.json, or null),
ground_offset (model units: how far its origin sits ABOVE the ground; negative buries it), scale,
scale_random (each plant draws a factor in [1 - a, 1 + a], a <= 0.9), footprint (radius in cells, at
scale 1), height (the top of the model above its origin, model units), wind (0 still to 1)}.
A missing number takes its default (0, 1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 0.5); one of another type refuses the file.
plants    a flat array of numbers, 7 per plant: model id, x, y, z (the point ON THE GROUND, FORMAT space), yaw
(radians around +Y), scale (the plant's own draw), mode (0 placed in the air, 1 planted).
A plant of an unknown model refuses the file.
A plant's model sits at T = translate(p + (0, ground_offset s, 0)) rotateY(yaw) scale(s), s = model.scale * plant
scale; its height above the ground is max(0, (height + ground_offset) s).
WIND (each engine writes its own shader on the same data): per plant (ground = p.y, height above ground,
phase = (0.37 p.x + 0.71 p.z) mod 2 pi, amplitude = wind). In WORLD space, for a vertex P with normal N at time t:
h = clamp((P.y - ground) / height, 0, 1); b = 0.35 + 0.6 sin(1.1 t + phase) + 0.3 sin(2.3 t + 1.7 phase);
P.xz += normalize(1.0, 0.34999999403954) b amplitude height 0.05 h^2; then P += N sin(7 t + P.(2.1, 1.7, 2.9)) 0.015 amplitude h.
A height of 0 does not move.
PLACING (feuillage.gd). r = footprint * s (s = model scale * plant scale). Modes: air, free, overflow.
1. Neighbours, in EVERY mode: reach = max(spacing, 0.05), or max(that, r + the largest r of the plants already
there) in free. For each plant q within reach in the plane (and |q.y - p.y| <= reach + 2): planar distance d <
0.05 → already_there; d < spacing → too_close; free and d < r + r_q → too_close.
2. air: the cell floor(p) full → in_matter; else planted. (Only the plane of the grid is asked.)
3. Planted (free, overflow): normal.y (normalized) < cos(max_slope) - 1e-6 → too_steep; water at p + (0, 0.1, 0)
→ in_water, where water at q = the cell (floor(q.x), floor(q.y + 0.2), floor(q.z)) holds water. overflow:
planted.
4. free: for the 8 points of the footprint circle (angle 2 pi k / 8, radius r), the ground below p.y + 1 must
exist and be within 0.35 of p.y → else at_edge. Then for the centre and those points at HALF the radius,
every cell from floor(p.y + 0.3) to floor(p.y + max(height above ground, 0.3)) must be empty → else
under_matter. Planted.
The BRUSH: for each candidate (x, z) in order: planted modes look for the ground below y_top (none → no_ground;
else p.y = ground, normal = its normal); air puts p.y = y_top and normal = up. Then the draw (yaw, scale — given
in the cases; in the app a random generator draws a, d then yaw, scale), then the check; an accepted plant joins
the plants AT ONCE (two candidates of one stroke respect each other).
GROUND OF CELLS (no tiles: these cases): in column (floor(x), floor(z)), from y = floor(y_top) - 1 down to -64,
the first FULL cell whose cell above is empty: ground y + 1, normal up; none → null. On real tiles the app
casts a vertical ray against the placed tiles' triangles instead (a quarter cell below the cells' top on the
thinned witness) — an engine does the same against its own tile meshes.
CASES — the world is world_cells (its ground is the ground of cells, below); water_cells hold water; models
by id; plants: the plants already there, 7 numbers each as in world.json. check → the refusal ("" = planted);
brush → the accepted plants [x, y, z, yaw, scale] in order and the refusals counted by reason; place → the
basis columns and origin of T, and the height above the ground; wind_data → [ground, height, phase, amplitude];
sway → the moved vertex; ground_of_cells → y or null; read: world.json in, foliage out or {"error": true}.
